original_measurement.resource_review: public1015 native_open_ms mean +14.042323945665958%, or +4.83838375 ms, across four starts per engine

corpus.name: public1015
corpus.policy: Load and verify the same parsed public1015 corpus before each startup. Retain it in the worker until startup measurement finishes. Do not ingest it or execute recall. No substitute corpus.

design.process: One fresh sequential subprocess for every sample; one new empty SQLite database on the same filesystem. No concurrent benchmarks, explicit GC changes or cache dropping.
design.timed_boundary: Immediately before with MemoryBook(db_path, cache_size=0), ending immediately after __enter__, as in the original native_open_ms. Import, source hashing, corpus loading, close and cleanup are excluded.
record: full schedule and all failed/interrupted records
design.traces: After all timed samples, one additional untimed fresh subprocess per engine captures the empty-database SQL trace and initialization schema/AST identities. Trace instrumentation is never enabled in the timed samples.
design.durability: Exclusively create a started manifest before the first sample; append, flush and fsync each sample to a JSONL ledger. Existing attempts must not be overwritten or repeated. Stop on the first failed sample and retain it.

interpretation.purpose: Explain the concrete original startup resource flag without repeating the recall performance experiment.
interpretation.not_a_replacement: The original report, all 47320 recall calls, startup observations, accepted=false and numeric gate remain unchanged. This diagnostic does not add query speed evidence or certify the absence of a startup regression.
interpretation.review: Independent review must state the original +4.83838375 ms absolute change and retain the high candidate first sample. Compare all diagnostic samples, CPU/wall separation, source and SQL equality. If a systematic excess remains or initialization work differs, keep acceptance unresolved. Any inference of host/I/O variability must be labeled as an inference: a later host cannot identify the precise event during the original outlier.
interpretation.scope: A fresh startup diagnostic on the current host is a targeted investigation, not an identical replay of the original hosted machine, its GC state, operating-system caches or storage load. No automatic acceptance override.
